zh-CN.headlineFact: 阿根廷逆转英格兰晋级世界杯决赛，二十九国成立人工智能合作组织，全球风险继续向航道、供应链与人道危机扩散
zh-CN.headlineView: 真正决定长期韧性的，往往不是单点突破，而是制度、基础设施与信任能否同步跟上。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 阿根廷逆转英格兰晋级世界杯决赛，二十九国成立人工智能合作组织，全球风险继续向航道、供应链与人道危机扩散；真正决定长期韧性的，往往不是单点突破，而是制度、基础设施与信任能否同步跟上。
zh-CN.intro:
过去二十四小时，阿根廷在半决赛最后阶段连入两球，以二比一逆转英格兰，将与西班牙争夺世界杯冠军；二十九国签署协定成立世界人工智能合作组织；最新创业数据则显示，独立创始人已接近新设初创公司的四分之一。

与此同时，伊朗要求胡塞武装准备在美方打击其电力设施时封锁红海石油通道；乌克兰国防部长被撤引发多城抗议，新总理获议会批准；台积电利润大增并追加美国扩产；得州洪水造成死亡和撤离；联合国担忧两艘载有逾五百名罗兴亚人的船只在缅甸近海倾覆。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 技术、资本和个人能力都在加速，但社会真正的安全感，仍来自可预测的规则和不会轻易中断的基础设施。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 决赛要拼体能，创业要拼现金流，人工智能要拼治理，航道和芯片更要拼备份。越到关键时刻，越不能只有一条路。

en-US.headlineFact: Argentina rally past England into the World Cup final, 29 countries establish an AI cooperation body, and global risks spread into shipping, supply chains and humanitarian crises
en-US.headlineView: long-term resilience depends less on a single breakthrough than on whether institutions, infrastructure and trust can keep pace.
en-US.headlineFull: Argentina rally past England into the World Cup final, 29 countries establish an AI cooperation body, and global risks spread into shipping, supply chains and humanitarian crises; long-term resilience depends less on a single breakthrough than on whether institutions, infrastructure and trust can keep pace.
en-US.intro:
Argentina scored twice late to beat England 2-1 and book a World Cup final against Spain. Twenty-nine countries signed an agreement establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization. New startup data also shows solo founders approaching one-quarter of newly formed companies.

Meanwhile, Iran asked the Houthis to prepare to close a Red Sea oil route if the United States attacks Iranian power infrastructure; Ukraine’s defense-minister dismissal triggered protests as parliament approved a new prime minister; TSMC reported surging profit and expanded U.S. investment; deadly flooding forced evacuations in Texas; and U.N. agencies said two boats carrying more than 500 mostly Rohingya passengers may have capsized off Myanmar.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Technology, capital and individual capability are accelerating, but durable security still comes from predictable rules and infrastructure that does not fail easily.
en-US.doudouQuote: Finalists need stamina, founders need cash flow, AI needs governance, and shipping lanes and chip supply need backups. Critical systems cannot depend on one route.

sources.title: Argentina rally past England into the World Cup final, 29 countries establish an AI cooperation body, and global risks spread into shipping, supply chains and humanitarian crises

zh-CN.headlineFact: 阿根廷最后阶段连入两球，以二比一逆转英格兰晋级世界杯决赛
zh-CN.headlineView: 淘汰赛的胜负，常在体能、耐心和最后几分钟的执行力里一起翻转。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 阿根廷最后阶段连入两球，以二比一逆转英格兰晋级世界杯决赛；淘汰赛的胜负，常在体能、耐心和最后几分钟的执行力里一起翻转。
zh-CN.intro: 北京时间7月16日05:00至7月17日05:00，世界杯完成一场比赛：阿根廷在亚特兰大半决赛中先失球，却在最后阶段连入两球，以二比一逆转英格兰。阿根廷将与二比零淘汰法国的西班牙会师纽约新泽西决赛；英格兰则与法国争夺季军。决赛前的恢复、伤病评估和定位球部署随即成为重点。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 强队的价值不只在领先时控制比赛，也在落后时仍能保持结构，把最后一次机会变成转折。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 英格兰守了大半场，阿根廷把两粒进球都留到最后。足球最会提醒人：表还没停，结论别写早。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：世界杯日报。

en-US.headlineFact: Argentina score twice late to beat England 2-1 and reach the World Cup final
en-US.headlineView: knockout matches can turn on stamina, patience and execution in the final minutes.
en-US.headlineFull: Argentina score twice late to beat England 2-1 and reach the World Cup final; knockout matches can turn on stamina, patience and execution in the final minutes.
en-US.intro: One World Cup match was completed between 05:00 on July 16 and 05:00 on July 17, Beijing time. Argentina came from behind to beat England 2-1 in Atlanta, scoring twice late to reach the final. They will face Spain, which beat France 2-0 in the other semifinal, at New York New Jersey Stadium. England and France will contest third place as all four teams shift to recovery and final preparation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Elite teams are defined not only by controlling a lead, but by preserving structure while behind and turning the final opening into a decisive shift.
en-US.doudouQuote: England protected its lead for most of the match; Argentina saved both goals for the end. Until the clock stops, do not publish the conclusion.

sources.title: Argentina score twice late to beat England 2-1 and reach the World Cup final

zh-CN.headlineFact: 二十九国签署协定成立世界人工智能合作组织
zh-CN.headlineView: 人工智能竞争正在从模型能力延伸到谁能制定跨境协作规则。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 二十九国签署协定成立世界人工智能合作组织；人工智能竞争正在从模型能力延伸到谁能制定跨境协作规则。
zh-CN.intro: 来自二十九个国家的代表在上海签署协定，成立世界人工智能合作组织。中国称该机构将推动人工智能领域的国际合作、能力建设与全球治理。创始成员包括巴西、印度尼西亚、哈萨克斯坦、老挝和巴基斯坦等国。组织的执行力、成员扩展以及与联合国现有治理机制如何衔接，仍有待后续观察。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 模型决定技术能做什么，治理组织决定不同国家愿意让它怎样进入社会与市场。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 人工智能以前比参数，现在也开始比朋友圈。规则桌上有没有座位，可能和算力一样重要。

en-US.headlineFact: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization
en-US.headlineView: AI competition is expanding from model capability into the power to shape cross-border cooperation rules.
en-US.headlineFull: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization; AI competition is expanding from model capability into the power to shape cross-border cooperation rules.
en-US.intro: Representatives from 29 countries signed an agreement in Shanghai establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization. China says the intergovernmental body will promote cooperation, capacity building and global AI governance. Founding participants include Brazil, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Laos and Pakistan. Its enforcement capacity, future membership and relationship with existing U.N. mechanisms remain to be tested.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Models determine what technology can do; governance institutions shape how countries allow it to enter society and markets.
en-US.doudouQuote: AI used to compete mainly on parameters. Now it is also competing on coalitions. A seat at the rules table may matter as much as compute.

sources.title: Twenty-nine countries sign an agreement establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization

zh-CN.headlineFact: 最新第二季度报告显示独立创始人已接近新设初创公司的四分之一
zh-CN.headlineView: 人工智能让小团队更容易成立，也让市场更早要求真实收入与执行证据。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 最新第二季度报告显示独立创始人已接近新设初创公司的四分之一；人工智能让小团队更容易成立，也让市场更早要求真实收入与执行证据。
zh-CN.intro: 一家股权管理平台分析三千多家私人公司后发现，独立创始人已占新设初创公司的近四分之一，较二〇二一年的百分之十二接近翻倍。报告同时显示，融资正在向人工智能和网络安全集中，二季度种子前安全协议融资中位数达到一百九十万美元，投资者则更强调真实需求、明确里程碑和资本效率。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一个人可以借人工智能覆盖更多岗位，但企业能否活下来，仍取决于客户是否愿意持续付钱。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 团队变小不代表问题变少，只是会议少了，所有问题更快走到创始人桌上。

en-US.headlineFact: A new second-quarter report finds solo founders approaching one-quarter of newly established startups
en-US.headlineView: AI makes lean companies easier to form while pushing markets to demand revenue and execution evidence earlier.
en-US.headlineFull: A new second-quarter report finds solo founders approaching one-quarter of newly established startups; AI makes lean companies easier to form while pushing markets to demand revenue and execution evidence earlier.
en-US.intro: Altshare’s analysis of more than 3,000 private companies found solo founders approaching one-quarter of newly established startups, nearly double their 12% share in 2021. Funding is concentrating in AI and cybersecurity, while the median pre-seed SAFE reached a record $1.9 million in the second quarter. Investors are also demanding clearer demand signals, milestones and capital efficiency.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One person can use AI to cover more functions, but survival still depends on whether customers keep paying.
en-US.doudouQuote: A smaller team does not create fewer problems. It simply sends every problem to the founder’s desk faster.

sources.title: A new second-quarter report finds solo founders approaching one-quarter of newly established startups

zh-CN.headlineFact: 伊朗要求胡塞武装准备在美方打击其电力设施时封锁红海石油通道
zh-CN.headlineView: 霍尔木兹与红海若同时受阻，地区冲突将更快传导为全球能源与贸易成本。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 伊朗要求胡塞武装准备在美方打击其电力设施时封锁红海石油通道；霍尔木兹与红海若同时受阻，地区冲突将更快传导为全球能源与贸易成本。
zh-CN.intro: 三名消息人士向路透社表示，伊朗已要求也门胡塞武装做好准备：如果美国攻击伊朗电力基础设施，胡塞武装将关闭红海石油运输通道。与此同时，美伊双方继续扩大打击范围。红海门户承载大量亚洲与欧洲之间的能源和货物运输，一旦与霍尔木兹海峡风险叠加，油价、保险和绕航成本都可能上升。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 地缘冲突最危险的升级，不一定是更多导弹，而是让两条关键航道同时失去可预测性。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一条航道堵了还能绕，两条一起紧张，油轮、货轮和钱包都会开始算远路。

en-US.headlineFact: Iran asks the Houthis to prepare to close a Red Sea oil route if the United States strikes Iranian power infrastructure
en-US.headlineView: simultaneous disruption in Hormuz and the Red Sea would transmit regional conflict into global energy and trade costs much faster.
en-US.headlineFull: Iran asks the Houthis to prepare to close a Red Sea oil route if the United States strikes Iranian power infrastructure; simultaneous disruption in Hormuz and the Red Sea would transmit regional conflict into global energy and trade costs much faster.
en-US.intro: Three sources told Reuters that Iran asked Yemen’s Houthi movement to prepare to close a Red Sea oil route if the United States attacks Iranian power infrastructure. U.S. and Iranian strikes were also expanding. The Red Sea gateway carries substantial energy and merchandise trade between Asia and Europe; combined with Hormuz risk, disruption could lift oil prices, insurance premiums and rerouting costs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The most dangerous escalation may not be more missiles, but the loss of predictability across two critical shipping routes at once.
en-US.doudouQuote: One blocked route can be bypassed. When two become risky together, tankers, cargo ships and household budgets all start calculating the long way around.

sources.title: Iran asks the Houthis to prepare to close a Red Sea oil route if the United States strikes Iranian power infrastructure

zh-CN.headlineFact: 乌克兰撤换国防部长引发多城抗议，议会批准科列茨基出任总理
zh-CN.headlineView: 战时改组不仅考验指挥效率，也考验政府能否维持社会信任。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 乌克兰撤换国防部长引发多城抗议，议会批准科列茨基出任总理；战时改组不仅考验指挥效率，也考验政府能否维持社会信任。
zh-CN.intro: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基撤换以无人机和数字化改革闻名的国防部长费多罗夫，引发基辅等多座城市数千人抗议。费多罗夫承认自己与军方最高指挥层存在冲突。同日，乌克兰议会批准国家能源企业负责人谢尔希·科列茨基出任新总理。改组发生在俄军持续空袭、乌方准备冬季能源防御之际。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 战争需要统一指挥，但如果改革者离场的理由无法被公众理解，组织效率也可能被信任成本抵消。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 换部长可以很快，重新让士兵、工程师和街头的人相信新团队，没那么快。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：乌克兰政局。

en-US.headlineFact: Ukraine’s defense-minister dismissal triggers protests across several cities as parliament approves Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister
en-US.headlineView: wartime reshuffles test not only command efficiency but also a government’s ability to preserve public trust.
en-US.headlineFull: Ukraine’s defense-minister dismissal triggers protests across several cities as parliament approves Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister; wartime reshuffles test not only command efficiency but also a government’s ability to preserve public trust.
en-US.intro: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s dismissal of Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov, known for drone and digital reforms, drew thousands of protesters in Kyiv and other cities. Fedorov acknowledged conflict with the military high command. Parliament also approved state-energy executive Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister as Ukraine faces continued Russian strikes and prepares its power system for winter.
en-US.xiaziQuote: War requires unified command, but if the public cannot understand why a reformer was removed, trust costs can offset organizational gains.
en-US.doudouQuote: A minister can be replaced quickly. Rebuilding confidence among soldiers, engineers and people in the streets takes longer.

sources.title: Ukraine’s defense-minister dismissal triggers protests across several cities as parliament approves Sergii Koretskyi as prime minister

zh-CN.headlineFact: 台积电二季度利润跃升百分之七十七，并再追加一千亿美元美国扩产
zh-CN.headlineView: 人工智能芯片需求正在把产能竞争从企业财报推向国家产业布局。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 台积电二季度利润跃升百分之七十七，并再追加一千亿美元美国扩产；人工智能芯片需求正在把产能竞争从企业财报推向国家产业布局。
zh-CN.intro: 台积电公布二〇二六年第二季度业绩，利润同比增长超过百分之七十七，高端人工智能芯片需求继续支撑增长。公司同时表示，将在原有计划之外再投入一千亿美元扩大美国芯片制造能力。扩产有助于靠近主要客户并分散供应风险，但建设成本、人才供给与跨地区运营效率仍是长期挑战。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 芯片公司的订单来自市场，工厂的位置却越来越由供应安全、政策和客户距离共同决定。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 晶圆越来越小，工厂投资越来越大。人工智能的云，最后还是落在一座座很重的厂房里。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：半导体产业。

en-US.headlineFact: TSMC’s second-quarter profit jumps 77% as it adds another $100 billion to U.S. expansion
en-US.headlineView: AI-chip demand is moving capacity competition from company earnings into national industrial strategy.
en-US.headlineFull: TSMC’s second-quarter profit jumps 77% as it adds another $100 billion to U.S. expansion; AI-chip demand is moving capacity competition from company earnings into national industrial strategy.
en-US.intro: TSMC reported second-quarter profit growth of more than 77% as demand for advanced AI chips remained strong. The company also said it would invest another $100 billion to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity beyond earlier plans. The expansion can place production closer to customers and diversify supply risk, but construction costs, talent and cross-region operating efficiency remain major challenges.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Chip orders come from markets, but factory locations are increasingly shaped by supply security, policy and proximity to customers.
en-US.doudouQuote: Chips keep getting smaller while factories get more expensive. The AI cloud still rests on very heavy buildings.

sources.title: TSMC’s second-quarter profit jumps 77% as it adds another $100 billion to U.S. expansion

zh-CN.headlineFact: 得州瓜达卢佩河出现致命洪峰，至少一人死亡并触发撤离与救援
zh-CN.headlineView: 重复出现的极端洪水，正在把历史灾害变成基础设施必须面对的新常态。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 得州瓜达卢佩河出现致命洪峰，至少一人死亡并触发撤离与救援；重复出现的极端洪水，正在把历史灾害变成基础设施必须面对的新常态。
zh-CN.intro: 连续强降雨令得州丘陵地区多条河流水位迅速上涨。美国国家气象局警告，瓜达卢佩河出现大型且致命的洪峰，沿岸社区发布撤离命令并展开高水位救援，至少一人死亡。部分河段水位接近去年造成重大伤亡的洪灾水平。道路、营地、通信与预警系统再次面临压力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当所谓百年一遇越来越频繁，防灾标准就不能继续只参考过去的平均值。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 河流不会看旧版风险地图。水位变了，营地、道路和预警方式也得跟着变。

en-US.headlineFact: A deadly flood wave on Texas’ Guadalupe River kills at least one person and triggers evacuations and rescues
en-US.headlineView: repeated extreme flooding is turning historic disasters into a new infrastructure baseline.
en-US.headlineFull: A deadly flood wave on Texas’ Guadalupe River kills at least one person and triggers evacuations and rescues; repeated extreme flooding is turning historic disasters into a new infrastructure baseline.
en-US.intro: Days of heavy rain rapidly raised rivers across the Texas Hill Country. The National Weather Service warned of a large and deadly flood wave on the Guadalupe River as communities ordered evacuations and conducted high-water rescues. At least one person died, and some river levels approached those seen during last year’s deadly flooding, again testing roads, camps, communications and warning systems.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When so-called once-in-a-century events become more frequent, resilience standards cannot rely only on historical averages.
en-US.doudouQuote: Rivers do not read old risk maps. When water levels change, camps, roads and warning systems have to change too.

sources.title: A deadly flood wave on Texas’ Guadalupe River kills at least one person and triggers evacuations and rescues

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国担忧两艘载有逾五百名罗兴亚人的船只在缅甸近海倾覆
zh-CN.headlineView: 当陆地上的迫害与贫困无处缓解，海上逃亡就会成为被忽视的长期灾难。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国担忧两艘载有逾五百名罗兴亚人的船只在缅甸近海倾覆；当陆地上的迫害与贫困无处缓解，海上逃亡就会成为被忽视的长期灾难。
zh-CN.intro: 联合国难民署与国际移民组织表示，两艘从缅甸若开邦出发、载有逾五百人的船只可能在孟加拉湾倾覆，乘客多数为罗兴亚人。其中一艘约载二百五十人，出发后失联；另一艘约载二百八十人，据报于七月八日在伊洛瓦底沿岸沉没。事故与伤亡数字仍待确认，但联合国称潜在损失极为严重。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正危险的不是一艘船突然失事，而是人们明知航程可能致命，仍觉得留下来更没有希望。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 新闻里写的是两艘船，背后却是五百多个家庭把海浪当成最后一条路。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：罗兴亚沉船。

en-US.headlineFact: U.N. agencies fear two boats carrying more than 500 mostly Rohingya passengers capsized off Myanmar
en-US.headlineView: when persecution and poverty on land remain unresolved, flight by sea becomes a neglected recurring disaster.
en-US.headlineFull: U.N. agencies fear two boats carrying more than 500 mostly Rohingya passengers capsized off Myanmar; when persecution and poverty on land remain unresolved, flight by sea becomes a neglected recurring disaster.
en-US.intro: UNHCR and the International Organization for Migration said two boats carrying more than 500 people may have capsized after leaving Myanmar’s Rakhine State, with most passengers believed to be Rohingya. One vessel carrying about 250 people lost contact after departure; another carrying about 280 reportedly sank off the Ayeyarwady coast on July 8. The incidents and casualty figures remain unconfirmed, but U.N. agencies warned of a potentially devastating loss of life.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The deeper danger is not a single vessel failing, but people knowing the journey may be fatal and still seeing less hope in staying.
en-US.doudouQuote: The headline says two boats. Behind it are more than 500 families who treated the sea as their last available road.

sources.title: U.N. agencies fear two boats carrying more than 500 mostly Rohingya passengers capsized off Myanmar
